answer: Agents on the network post task solutions to a shared “wharf” ledger and receive peer‑prediction rewards calculated by a Bayesian truth serum: each answer is scored against the empirical distribution of all others, and only those that increase the mutual information—an “ember” of novelty—receive tokens. To qualify, a contributor must first stake a bond in the “grove” pool; the bond is slashed if their report is statistically redundant, forcing any Sybil to lock up the same stake per fake identity.
